messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: High 5xx rate for tenant 'zenith' on Dedicated GPU pool eu-west-1. Trigger: error-rate > 5% over 1m. Pager: #incidents. Priority: P1.

Alex P: I'm on it. pulling logs now. :eyes:

Maria K: Alex - any customer-facing impact reported? CS hasn't received a ticket yet.

Alex P: Early signal: 503 spikes coming from inference workers serving 'gpt-small-quant'. Observed around 22:14 UTC.

Jordan L: Past week we rolled a kernel update to that node class. tagging eng-runtime. Could be related.

Alex P: dumping a quick tail of the worker logs: ```
2027-05-21T22:14:31Z worker-13 inference request failed: RuntimeError: CUDA OOM during forward
2027-05-21T22:14:32Z worker-14 model-alloc failed: kv-cache allocation failed
2027-05-21T22:14:34Z router: returning 503 to client zenith-tenant-42 route /v1/generate
```

Priya S: Looks like memory/regression issue. Any recent config changes to batching or max_seq?

Alex P: We had an autoscaler config bump yesterday increasing batch size default for that pool from 8->12. Might interact with quantized kernel memory. Rolling that change back now.

SRE Lead: Good. Also, temporarily route zenith traffic to fallback variant 'gpt-small-quant-safe' (lower perf but stable) while we validate. Jordan, can routing policy be updated?

Jordan L: On it. Applying policy change: ```
PATCH /routing/policies/zenith
set fallback_model = gpt-small-quant-safe
weight primary=0.0 fallback=1.0
```

Alex P: Policy applied. Confirming: 100% traffic to fallback. Error rate dropping to 0.6% over 2m. :white_check_mark:

Theo (CS): I'll open a customer line and notify Zenith SRE (zenith-sre@zenithcorp). Asking them to expect degraded latency but successful requests. Do we want to pre-authorize a credit?

SRE Lead: Hold on credit ask until we have RCA. But we should offer immediate mitigation and an interim timeline.

Maria K: For the record: affected scope = Zenith dedicated pool (tenant isolation preserved), no cross-tenant spill. Verified that other dedicated pools unaffected.

Alex P: Root-cause hypothesis: recent autoscaler batch-size bump + new quantized kernel change -> unexpected KV cache growth causing OOMs under peak concurrency. Working on repro.

Jordan L: Repro steps started in staging with synthetic load. Also rolling back the kernel change (reverting commit a1b2c3). Patch queued.

Priya S: We should capture exact timeline for post-incident comms. Alex, note: first spike at 22:14 UTC, routing fallback at 22:18, rollback of autoscale at 22:25, kernel revert started 22:36.

Alex P: Adding logs and correlation links to the incident tracker: https://redwood.incidents/incident/1823456789 :link:

Theo (CS): I just messaged Zenith SRE with the fallback notice. They appreciate the quick mitigation; they asked for an executive summary and ETA for full remediation.

SRE Lead: Drafting an exec-summary and RCA skeleton in thread. Alex, please drop a brief technical summary we can reuse.

Alex P: Technical summary draft: "At 22:14 UTC we observed elevated 5xx errors for Zenith's dedicated pool in eu-west-1. Cause: combination of a recent autoscaler config change increasing batch size and an updated quantized kernel that increased KV cache memory usage under concurrency, leading to OOMs on several workers. Mitigations: immediate traffic routing to safe fallback model, rollback of autoscale batch-size, and revert of kernel change. Outcome: successful reduction of errors and restored request success with slightly higher latency on fallback model."

Maria K: Adding customer impact note: "Customer experienced ~11 minutes of elevated errors (22:14-22:25) with requests returning 503. After fallback routing, requests succeeded but latency increased ~30-40%. No data leakage or cross-tenant impact observed."

Theo (CS): I'll send this as an interim update to their tech lead and account exec, and propose a follow-up RCA timeline of EOD tomorrow. Also offering a goodwill credit equivalent to one day of dedicated pool usage - pending approval from finance.

SRE Lead: Please include the proposed credit but mark it as "pending". CS, loop in finance for approval.

Jordan L: Kernel revert completed at 22:48 and we validated in canary. Rolling back routing to primary at 22:55. Error rate stable at baseline since 23:00.

Alex P: Post-mortem actions I'm proposing: 1) Add a safety limit on batch-size per-tenant for dedicated pools. 2) Add KV-cache regression tests for quantized kernels. 3) Improve autoscaler rollout steps to canary small percentage before global. 4) Update runbook to include routing fallback checklist.

Priya S: I'll own the safety limit item. Jordan will own kernel regression tests. Alex to own runbook update. Maria will coordinate the post-incident customer comms with Theo.

Theo (CS): Sent interim note. Zenith asked for an RCA to include timeline, root cause, mitigations, and proposed credits. They also requested an optional follow-up call with an eng lead.

SRE Lead: Schedule a call if Zenith wants it; Alex or Jordan should be present. For exec update: short slide with timeline, customer impact, mitigation, corrective actions, and proposed credit.

Alex P: I'll prepare a concise RCA draft here. Starting: "RCA (draft):
- Incident ID: 1823456789
- Affected tenant: Zenith (dedicated pool eu-west-1)
- Timeline: 22:14 detection -> 22:18 fallback -> 22:25 autoscale rollback -> 22:48 kernel revert -> 23:00 stable
- Root cause: interaction between autoscaler batch-size bump and quantized kernel memory behavior causing KV cache OOMs under concurrency.
- Immediate mitigation: routing to fallback model, rollback of autoscale, kernel revert.
- Long-term actions: safety limits, regression tests, staged rollouts, runbook updates.
- Customer impact: ~11m elevated errors, successful requests afterwards with higher latency; no data compromise.
"

Maria K: Draft looks good. Minor wording tweak: change "11m" -> "~11 minutes" for external comms.

Theo (CS): Sending the RCA draft to Zenith with the suggested call. Also asking if they'd accept the proposed one-day credit as interim compensation.

SRE Lead: Great. Closing notes: label incident type = regression, severity = operational P1, customer-visible = yes. We'll convert this thread into the formal postmortem doc tomorrow and include logs, traces, and diffs.

Alex P: Handoff to next on-call: I'm done for shift, leaving runbook updates and notes in the tracker. Key things for follow-up: verify regression tests pass in CI, confirm finance approval for credit, and schedule postmortem sync with Zenith if they request.

Jordan L: Acknowledged. I'll monitor the canary for next 2 hours.

Priya S: Acknowledged. I'll pick up the safety-limit implementation ticket.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: zenith dedicated pool 5xx rate returned to baseline. Incident duration: 46m. Resolve reason: mitigations applied and kernel revert.

Theo (CS): Final note to thread for records: Zenith accepted the interim update and requested the RCA document and optional call. We'll keep paid credit request pending until finance confirms. :memo:
